If the flag is instead disabled (recommended choice), the 'Sell to' customer of the invoice header will be retrieved from the order, in case of a single 'Sell to' present in the combined shipments; otherwise, it will be forced to match the 'Bill to' customer
trans-unit.target: Wenn dieses Feld aktiviert ist, wird der "Verkäufer an"-Kunde aus dem Rechnungskopf immer aus dem "Verkauf an" des ersten bearbeiteten Auftrags abgerufen. trans-unit.source: The "Reference Date" used by the "Invoicing Method" to filter in the "From Date"/"To Date" range. The reference date is also used for "Posting Date", "Document Date", "Shipment Date" and "Order Date", if the "Posting Date" is not specified in the "Invoice Data" group. As "Operation Occured Date" if "Operation Occurred Date" is not specified in the "Invoice Data" group.
trans-unit.target: Das "Referenzdatum", das von der "Rechnungsmethode" verwendet wird, um im Bereich "Von Datum"/"Bis Datum" zu filtern. Als "Operation Occurred Date", wenn "Operation Occurred Date" nicht in der Gruppe "Invoice Data" angegeben ist.
